notes: Rule parameters for deterministic card generation (spec 5.7). Cards are derived only from review-passed structured content: one WORD_MEANING card per learnable sense, one CONTEXT_MEANING card per qualified real-exam example carrying a review-passed contextual meaning, one PHRASE card per approved source phrase, and one SENSE_DISCRIMINATION card per review-confirmed confusable candidate. Template versions are recorded on generated cards but never participate in content_card_key derivation, so a template change cannot create new cards or sever user FSRS state.
